# m-stash

> A small, self-hostable API that gives an app authentication plus per-user and app-wide data on MongoDB, with record ownership enforced server-side. Built for AI-built apps: add sign-up, login, and private per-user data without wiring a database or writing security rules.

Every request identifies its app with the header `X-M-Stash-App: <publishableKey>`. The browser never receives database credentials and never chooses an owner; the server derives ownership from the authenticated session.

## Core concepts

- **Personal data**: owned by the signed-in user. The server scopes every record to its owner.
- **Shared app data**: owned by the deployment/admin. Writes require an admin session or the app secret key (backend only).
- **type**: a bucket name, e.g. `config`, `save`, `profile`, `leaderboard`.
- **visibility** (per record): `private` (owner only), `authenticated` (any signed-in user), or `public` (anyone).

## Endpoints

- `POST /v1/apps` — provision an app (needs the platform token). Returns a publishable key (`pk_...`, safe in the browser) and a one-time secret key (`sk_...`, backend only).
- `POST /v1/auth/signup` — body `{ email, password, username }`. Your users sign up in your app.
- `POST /v1/auth/login` — body `{ email, password }`. Browser flows also set HttpOnly session cookies.
- `GET|POST /v1/me/resources/{type}` and `GET|PUT|DELETE /v1/me/resources/{type}/{slug}` — personal data. Body `{ slug, title, data, visibility }`.
- `GET|POST /v1/shared/resources/{type}` and `/{type}/{slug}` — shared app data; writes require admin or the app secret key.
- `GET /v1/public/shared/resources/{type}/{slug}` — read one public shared record (no auth).
- `GET /v1/public/{username}/{type}/{slug}` — read one public personal record (no auth).
- `GET /.well-known/m-stash.json` — machine-readable service manifest.

## Example

```bash
# Read a public record — no auth, just the app key header.
curl "$API_URL/v1/public/shared/resources/config/release" -H "X-M-Stash-App: $APP_KEY"

# Create a private record for the signed-in user.
curl -X POST "$API_URL/v1/me/resources/save" \
  -H "X-M-Stash-App: $APP_KEY" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"slug":"current","title":"Save slot","data":{"level":7},"visibility":"private"}'
```

## Rules for generated code

- Always send `X-M-Stash-App: <publishableKey>` on every request.
- Never put the secret key (`sk_...`), platform token, or MongoDB credentials in browser code.
- Never let the browser choose an owner — the server assigns it from the session.
- Pick `visibility` deliberately: default to `private`; use `public` only for records meant for everyone.
